verdict.rationale: Undermind is purpose-built for scholarly literature search: it runs deep literature reviews over papers, reads full-text PDFs including figures/tables/equations, and traces claims back to source papers via citations, with independent community reports confirming it surfaces relevant academic papers beyond Google Scholar. Some community feedback notes gaps in coverage (dissertations, gray literature), which tempers but doesn't negate the core capability. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark on primary-source/preprint coverage breadth, and some users report missed gray literature/theses.
